en.headline: 17 killed in two mass shootings in South Africa
en.body: Two separate incidents resulted in 17 deaths. In the first, six men and three women were found shot dead inside a shack near Pretoria. A second shooting in KwaZulu-Natal province left additional dead, according to Anadolu Ajansı and DW.com.

it.headline: 17 morti in due sparatorie di massa in Sudafrica
it.body: Due incidenti separati hanno provocato 17 morti. Nel primo, sono stati trovati morti sei uomini e tre donne all'interno di una capanna vicino a Pretoria. Una seconda sparatoria nella provincia di KwaZulu-Natal ha lasciato ulteriori vittime, secondo Anadolu Ajansı e DW.com.

de.headline: 17 Tote bei zwei Schießereien in Südafrika
de.body: Bei zwei separaten Vorfällen kamen 17 Menschen ums Leben. Bei dem ersten fanden Polizisten sechs Männer und drei Frauen in einer Hütte nahe Pretoria erschossen vor. Bei einer zweiten Schießerei in der Provinz KwaZulu-Natal kamen weitere Menschen ums Leben, wie Anadolu Ajansı und DW.com berichteten.

fr.headline: 17 tués dans deux fusillades en Afrique du Sud
fr.body: Deux incidents distincts ont entraîné 17 décès. Dans le premier, six hommes et trois femmes ont été retrouvés abattus à l'intérieur d'une case près de Pretoria. Une seconde fusillade dans la province du KwaZulu-Natal a laissé un nombre supplémentaire de morts, selon Anadolu Ajansı et DW.com.

es.headline: 17 muertos en dos tiroteos en Sudáfrica
es.body: Dos incidentes separados provocaron 17 fallecidos. En el primero, seis hombres y tres mujeres fueron encontrados muertos a tiros dentro de una choza cerca de Pretoria. Un segundo tiroteo en la provincia de KwaZulu-Natal dejó víctimas adicionales, según Anadolu Ajansı y DW.com.

pt.headline: 17 mortos em dois tiroteios na África do Sul
pt.body: Dois incidentes separados resultaram em 17 mortes. No primeiro, seis homens e três mulheres foram encontrados mortos a tiro dentro de um casebre perto de Pretória. Um segundo tiroteio na província de KwaZulu-Natal deixou mortos adicionais, segundo Anadolu Ajansı e DW.com.

ja.headline: 南アフリカで2件の大量銃撃事件、17人死亡
ja.body: 2件の別々の事件で17人が死亡。まず、プレトリア近郊の小屋で男性6人、女性3人の計9人が銃撃され死亡しているのが見つかった。2件目はクワズール・ナタール州で起き、アナドル通信とDW.comによれば追加で犠牲者が出た。

zh.headline: 南非两起枪击案致17人死亡
zh.body: 两起分离事件导致17人死亡。第一起事件在比勒陀利亚附近的一间小屋内发现6名男性和3名女性被射杀。第二起枪击案在夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省造成 additional 死亡，据安纳多通讯社和德国之声报道。

ko.headline: 남아프리카 공화국에서 발생한 두 건의 총기 난사 사건으로 17명 사망
ko.body: 두 건의 별도 사건으로 17명이 사망했습니다. 첫 번째 사건에서는 프리토리아 인근 오두막 안에서 남성 6명과 여성 3명이 총에 맞아 숨진 채 발견되었습니다. 두 번째는 KwaZulu-Natal 주에서 발생했으며, 추가 사망자가 발생했습니다. Anadolu Ajansı와 DW.com의 보도에 따르면입니다.

en.headline: Nine shot dead in Atteridgeville mass shooting
en.body: Nine people were shot dead in Atteridgeville. The Mail & Guardian and yfm.co.za report the incident, with Y WORLD noting nine people killed in the Atteridgeville mass shooting.

it.headline: Nove morti in una sparatoria di massa ad Atteridgeville
it.body: Nove persone sono state uccise a colpi di pistola ad Atteridgeville. Il Mail & Guardian e yfm.co.za riportano l'incidente, con Y WORLD che segnala nove morti nella sparatoria di Atteridgeville.

de.headline: Neun Menschen bei Massenschießerei in Atteridgeville getötet
de.body: Neun Menschen wurden in Atteridgeville erschossen. Nach Angaben der Mail & Guardian und yfm.co.za kamen bei der Massenschießerei in Atteridgeville neun Menschen ums Leben, wie Y WORLD berichtete.

fr.headline: Neuf personnes tuées dans une fusillade à Atteridgeville
fr.body: Neuf personnes ont été tuées par balles à Atteridgeville. Le Mail & Guardian et yfm.co.za rapportent l'incident, Y WORLD faisant état de neuf personnes tuées dans la fusillade d'Atteridgeville.

es.headline: Nine muertos en tiroteo en Atteridgeville
es.body: Nine personas fueron tiroteadas y muertas en Atteridgeville. El Mail & Guardian y yfm.co.za informan el incidente, con Y WORLD señalando nueve personas fallecidas en el tiroteo de Atteridgeville.

pt.headline: Nove mortos a tiro em tiroteio em Atteridgeville
pt.body: Nove pessoas foram mortas a tiro em Atteridgeville. O The Mail & Guardian e o yfm.co.za reportam o incidente, com o Y WORLD a referir nove pessoas mortas no tiroteio de Atteridgeville.

ja.headline: アタデジビルでの大量銃撃事件で9人死亡
ja.body: アタデジビルで9人が銃撃され死亡した。マール・アンド・ガーディアンとyfm.co.zaが報じており、Y WORLDもアタデジビルでの大量銃撃事件で9人が死亡したと伝えている。

zh.headline: 阿泰维尔大屠杀致9人遇难
zh.body: 9人在阿泰维尔枪击案中遇难。《每日邮报》和yfm.co.za报道了此事，Y WORLD指出阿泰维尔大屠杀造成9人死亡。

ko.headline: 애터리지빌 총기 난사 사건으로 9명 사망
ko.body: 애터리지빌에서 9명이 총에 맞아 사망했습니다. Mail & Guardian과 yfm.co.za가 이 사건을 보도했으며, Y WORLD는 애터리지빌 총기 난사 사건으로 9명이 사망했다고 전했습니다.

en.title: 17 killed in two mass shootings in South Africa
en.dek: Two separate incidents resulted in 17 deaths across Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal provinces
facts: 17 killed in two separate mass shooting incidents on 2026-11-16
Six men and three women found shot dead inside a shack near Pretoria
Second shooting in KwaZulu-Natal province left additional dead
Nine people shot dead in Atteridgeville mass shooting
body: On 2026-11-16, 17 people were killed in two separate mass shooting incidents in South Africa, according to Africanews and DW.com.
The first incident occurred near Pretoria where six men and three women were found shot dead inside a shack, as reported by Africanews and DW.com.
A second shooting in KwaZulu-Natal province resulted in additional deaths, with the total fatalities reaching 17 across both incidents.
In Atteridgeville, nine people were shot dead, with The Mail & Guardian and yfm.co.za reporting the incident, and Y WORLD noting nine people killed in the Atteridgeville mass shooting.
The nine deaths in Atteridgeville were reported separately from the Pretoria and KwaZulu-Natal incidents, with Y WORLD confirming the death toll at nine.
Authorities have not yet released official statements regarding motives or suspects in either series of shootings, according to the confirmed reports.
en.context: South Africa has been battling rising violent crime, with these shootings occurring amid ongoing concerns about gun violence in the country, as reported by Africanews.
